Re : CAN 2 of 2023 (Stay) This is an application for stay of operation of the impugned judgment and award dated 19th June, 2023 passed by the learned Additional District Judge-cum- Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Track 4th Court, Alipore in MAC Case No. 82 of 2013 under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-cum- Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fast Track 4th Court, Alipore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By such order dated 19th June, 2023, the learned Tribunal granted compensation in favour of the claimant to the tune of Rs. 6,88,127/- together with interest under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

Mr. M. P. Chakraborty, learned Advocate for the appellant-Insurance Company submits that the Insurance Company has already deposited the statutory amount and is ready and willing to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory deposit before learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta within such time as would be directed by this Court.

On such count,
he prays for stay of operation of the impugned judgment and award.
The report of the Computer Section, Appellate Side, High Court, Calcutta dated 12th October, 2023 shows that no caveat has been lodged.

The office report dated 17th October, 2023 shows deposit of statutory amount of Rs.25,000/- in terms of Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act with the Registry of this Court vide OD Challan No.
2116 dated 11.10.2023.
In view of readiness and willingness on the part of the appellant-Insurance Company to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory amount, there shall be stay of operation of the impugned judgment and award passed by the learned Tribunal till 2nd week of December, 2023.
The appellant-Insurance Company
is directed to deposit the entire awarded sum together with interest less statutory amount before the learned Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta within 2nd week of December, 2023.
In the event, the appellant-Insurance Company makes deposit of the aforesaid amount, the order of stay shall continue till the disposal of this application.
In default to make deposit of the aforesaid amount, the order of stay shall stand automatically vacated without reference to this Court.
